A:
Muscle gym me nahi... gym ke BAAD banta hai! 💪

Ek heavy session ke baad muscle protein banne ki speed: 3 ghante pe +112%, 24 ghante pe +65%, 48 ghante pe bhi +34%.
Protein ka fayda lagbhag 1.6 g per kg body weight per day tak badhta hai, uske baad plateau (49 studies ka meta-analysis).
8 hafte me reps badhana utna hi kaam aaya jitna weight badhana (43 trained lifters).

Takeaway: muscle recovery me banta hai, bas har hafte thoda zyada karo: ek rep ya thoda weight.

Tum progress kaise karte ho, reps badha ke ya weight badha ke? Comment karo 👇
Ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo saal bhar same weight uthata hai.
Source: Phillips et al. 1997 (Am J Physiol Endocrinol Metab); Morton et al. 2018 (Br J Sports Med); Plotkin et al. 2022 (PeerJ)

B:
Full squat ya half squat? Glutes ka jawab clear hai! 🏋️

Ek chhoti study: 17 untrained ladke, 10 hafte, hafte me 2 baar, full (~140° knee) vs half (90°), MRI se naapa.
Glutes: full +6.7% vs half +2.2%, lagbhag 3x!
Adductors: +6.2% vs +2.7%, 2x se zyada.
Quads: +4.9% vs +4.6%, barabar. Hamstrings dono me na ke barabar badle.

Takeaway: bade glutes chahiye to good form ke saath jitna deep ho sake utna squat karo; half squat extra hai, main squat nahi.

Tum kitna deep squat karte ho? Comment karo 👇
Ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo half squat maar ke leg day khatam kar deta hai.
Source: Kubo, Ikebukuro & Yata 2019 (Eur J Appl Physiol)
